mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT ( DB_CONFIG_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, TABLE_TYPE, OWNER_NAME ) VALUES
( #{dbConfigId}, #{item.tableName}, #{item.tableComment}, #{item.tableType}, #{item.tableOwner} )

INSERT INTO DBF_COLLECT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT (COLLECT_TABLE_ID, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_COMMENT, COLUMN_ORDER, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE_YN, DEFAULT_VALUE, IDENTITY_YN, IDENTITY_TYPE) VALUES
( #{item.tableSnapshotId}, #{item.columnName}, #{item.columnComment}, #{item.columnOrder}, #{item.dataType}, #{item.dataLength}, #{item.dataScale}, #{item.nullableYn}, #{item.defaultValue}, #{item.identityYn}, #{item.identityType} )
mapper.select: SELECT COLLECT_TABLE_ID AS TABLE_SNAPSHOT_ID , DB_CONFIG_ID , TABLE_NAME , TABLE_COMMENT , TABLE_TYPE , OWNER_NAME FROM DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

SELECT COL.COLLECT_COLUMN_ID AS COLUMN_SNAPSHOT_ID , COL.COLLECT_TABLE_ID AS TABLE_SNAPSHOT_ID , COL.COLUMN_NAME , COL.COLUMN_COMMENT , COL.COLUMN_ORDER , COL.DATA_TYPE , COL.DATA_LENGTH , COL.DATA_SCALE , COL.NULLABLE_YN , COL.DEFAULT_VALUE , COL.IDENTITY_YN , COL.IDENTITY_TYPE FROM DBF_COLLECT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT COL INNER JOIN DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT TBL ON COL.COLLECT_TABLE_ID = TBL.COLLECT_TABLE_ID WHERE TBL.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} ORDER BY COL.COLLECT_TABLE_ID, COL.COLUMN_ORDER
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DBF_COLLECT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT WHERE COLLECT_TABLE_ID IN (SELECT COLLECT_TABLE_ID FROM DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId})
mapper.select: SELECT CURRENT_TABLE_ID AS TABLE_SNAPSHOT_ID , COMMIT_LOG_ID , DB_CONFIG_ID , TABLE_NAME , TABLE_COMMENT , TABLE_TYPE , OWNER_NAME FROM DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

SELECT COL.CURRENT_COLUMN_ID AS COLUMN_SNAPSHOT_ID , COL.CURRENT_TABLE_ID AS TABLE_SNAPSHOT_ID , COL.COLUMN_NAME , COL.COLUMN_COMMENT , COL.COLUMN_ORDER , COL.DATA_TYPE , COL.DATA_LENGTH , COL.DATA_SCALE , COL.NULLABLE_YN , COL.DEFAULT_VALUE , COL.IDENTITY_YN , COL.IDENTITY_TYPE FROM DBF_CURRENT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT COL INNER JOIN DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT TBL ON COL.CURRENT_TABLE_ID = TBL.CURRENT_TABLE_ID WHERE TBL.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId} ORDER BY COL.CURRENT_TABLE_ID, COL.COLUMN_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT (COMMIT_LOG_ID, DB_CONFIG_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, TABLE_TYPE, OWNER_NAME) SELECT #{commitLogId} , DB_CONFIG_ID , TABLE_NAME , TABLE_COMMENT , TABLE_TYPE , OWNER_NAME FROM DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_CURRENT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT (CURRENT_TABLE_ID, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_COMMENT, COLUMN_ORDER, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE_YN, DEFAULT_VALUE, IDENTITY_YN, IDENTITY_TYPE) SELECT CRT.CURRENT_TABLE_ID , CLC.COLUMN_NAME , CLC.COLUMN_COMMENT , CLC.COLUMN_ORDER , CLC.DATA_TYPE , CLC.DATA_LENGTH , CLC.DATA_SCALE , CLC.NULLABLE_YN , CLC.DEFAULT_VALUE , CLC.IDENTITY_YN , CLC.IDENTITY_TYPE FROM DBF_COLLECT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT CLC INNER JOIN DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT CLT ON CLC.COLLECT_TABLE_ID = CLT.COLLECT_TABLE_ID INNER JOIN DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT CRT ON CRT.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND CLT.DB_CONFIG_ID = CRT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND CLT.TABLE_NAME = CRT.TABLE_NAME AND CLT.TABLE_TYPE = CRT.TABLE_TYPE WHERE CLT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_HISTORY_TABLE_SNAPSHOT (COMMIT_LOG_ID, DB_CONFIG_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, TABLE_TYPE, OWNER_NAME, TABLE_DELETED_YN) SELECT #{commitLogId} , DB_CONFIG_ID , TABLE_NAME , TABLE_COMMENT , TABLE_TYPE , OWNER_NAME , 0 FROM DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_HISTORY_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT (HISTORY_TABLE_ID, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_COMMENT, COLUMN_ORDER, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE_YN, DEFAULT_VALUE, IDENTITY_YN, IDENTITY_TYPE) SELECT HTS.HISTORY_TABLE_ID , CLC.COLUMN_NAME , CLC.COLUMN_COMMENT , CLC.COLUMN_ORDER , CLC.DATA_TYPE , CLC.DATA_LENGTH , CLC.DATA_SCALE , CLC.NULLABLE_YN , CLC.DEFAULT_VALUE , CLC.IDENTITY_YN , CLC.IDENTITY_TYPE FROM DBF_COLLECT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT CLC INNER JOIN DBF_COLLECT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT CLT ON CLC.COLLECT_TABLE_ID = CLT.COLLECT_TABLE_ID INNER JOIN DBF_HISTORY_TABLE_SNAPSHOT HTS ON HTS.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND HTS.DB_CONFIG_ID = CLT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND CLT.TABLE_NAME = HTS.TABLE_NAME AND CLT.TABLE_TYPE = HTS.TABLE_TYPE AND HTS.TABLE_DELETED_YN = 0 WHERE CLT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_HISTORY_TABLE_SNAPSHOT (COMMIT_LOG_ID, DB_CONFIG_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, TABLE_TYPE, OWNER_NAME, TABLE_DELETED_YN) SELECT #{commitLogId} , CRT.DB_CONFIG_ID , CRT.TABLE_NAME , CRT.TABLE_COMMENT , CRT.TABLE_TYPE , CRT.OWNER_NAME , 1 FROM DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT CRT INNER JOIN DBF_COMMIT_TARGET DCT ON DCT.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND DCT.DB_CONFIG_ID = CRT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND DCT.OBJECT_NAME = CRT.TABLE_NAME AND DCT.OBJECT_TYPE = CRT.TABLE_TYPE AND DCT.CHANGE_TYPE = 'DEL'

INSERT INTO DBF_HISTORY_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT (HISTORY_TABLE_ID, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_COMMENT, COLUMN_ORDER, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE_YN, DEFAULT_VALUE, IDENTITY_YN, IDENTITY_TYPE) SELECT HST.HISTORY_TABLE_ID , CLC.COLUMN_NAME , CLC.COLUMN_COMMENT , CLC.COLUMN_ORDER , CLC.DATA_TYPE , CLC.DATA_LENGTH , CLC.DATA_SCALE , CLC.NULLABLE_YN , CLC.DEFAULT_VALUE , CLC.IDENTITY_YN , CLC.IDENTITY_TYPE FROM DBF_CURRENT_COLUMN_SNAPSHOT CLC INNER JOIN DBF_CURRENT_TABLE_SNAPSHOT CRT ON CLC.CURRENT_TABLE_ID = CRT.CURRENT_TABLE_ID INNER JOIN DBF_COMMIT_TARGET DCT ON DCT.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND DCT.DB_CONFIG_ID = CRT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND DCT.OBJECT_NAME = CRT.TABLE_NAME AND DCT.OBJECT_TYPE = CRT.TABLE_TYPE AND DCT.CHANGE_TYPE = 'DEL' INNER JOIN DBF_HISTORY_TABLE_SNAPSHOT HST ON HST.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND HST.DB_CONFIG_ID = CRT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND HST.TABLE_NAME = CRT.TABLE_NAME AND HST.TABLE_TYPE = CRT.TABLE_TYPE AND HST.TABLE_DELETED_YN = 1
